One-point deduction for unquoted inner-loop glob expansion (word-splitting risk on unusual filenames), stderr suppression on bash -n failures, and no bundle evidence confirming full-suite runtime behavior or latent syntax fixes elsewhere.

AI_REPO_GUIDE.md documents the expanded check per doc-sync expectations. Deductions for redirecting bash -n stderr to /dev/null (hides failure detail), nested unquoted glob loop being slightly less robust than a single collected array with per-file guards, and sparse inline rationale in the script itself (e.g., bats exclusion is implicit via glob set only).
